description: This file defines the abstract class 'AbstractWell' for a pseudo-random number generator based on the WELL (Waterloo) family of algorithms. It provides core functionality such as seed initialization, internal state management, and configuration for the generator's parameters.

classes.name: AbstractWell
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a WELL family pseudo-random number generator, providing basic seed setup, internal state management, and configuration based on parameters.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the generator with an individual int seed, int array seed, or long seed, setting the internal state accordingly.

methods.name: next
methods.description: An abstract method to generate the next random bits, to be implemented in subclasses.
